adjudicated_against: solution/kaggle/generated/gate-predeclared-2026-09-08-rcarry-run3.json, written while the run was still in status=running and before any benchmark.json was fetched

VERDICT.band_hit: 35.0 to 38.9 = HOLD IN THE ROTATION, and state plainly that three runs have NOT separated it from the control family
VERDICT.override_fired: YES. The predeclared override reads: 'If zero-level games rise above 6 (family 3 to 4), that is a breadth regression and downgrades a HOLD to a demoted claim regardless of the level total.' Run 3 returned 7 zeros.
VERDICT.final: HOLD in the rotation, CLAIM DEMOTED. rcarry is NOT established as better than control. It is the control.

WHAT_I_GOT_WRONG_THIS_MORNING: On n=2 (31 and 46) I promoted this arm into the daily rotation and wrote that it was 'above the control family on all three outcome statistics'. With the third run that reads +0.67 levels, +0.45 mean25 and +0.09 ex-ft09, with 1.5 MORE zero-level games. The two-run picture was carried entirely by run 2. The promotion itself is defensible under rule 15(b), which needs only a ~21% prior and a config that is not a measured regression, and the arm still is not one. The LANGUAGE was not defensible and is retracted.

THE_NUMBER_THAT_MATTERS_MOST_TODAY.why_it_matters_beyond_this_arm: This bench can return 46 from a config whose three-run mean is 35.7. That is a larger spread than the 6.8 we had been using, and it is the direct reason arm GG2's single 44 was NOT promoted today. A 44 is inside the range this instrument produces from an unchanged config.
THE_NUMBER_THAT_MATTERS_MOST_TODAY.consequence: raise the assumed single-run sd from 6.8 to about 9 levels when sizing any future gate, and treat every unreplicated single run above 40 as unproven.

what_survives_unchanged: The DEFECT is real and proven against the model's own chat template: thinking was stored under `reasoning` while the template reads `reasoning_content`, so 96% of model output was discarded before the next decision. That does not depend on any level count.
The repair is live in the shipped bytes and costs nothing.

rcarry stays in the rotation: pooled it is not a measured regression, it has zero board draws so its posterior is the widest we own, and on a max-keeping board that is worth draws. Rule 15(c) is not triggered.

The PHANTOM STRIP arm (built today, generated/gate-predeclared-2026-09-08-arm-PS-phantom-strip.json) is unaffected: it attacks the ESTIMATOR side of the same defect, not the rendering side, and its case never rested on rcarry's level count.
rotation_action_taken: R-rcarry stays at index 2. Its note in config_registry.json and daily_submit.sh is rewritten to say 'three runs, pooled 35.67 vs 35.0, NOT separated from control'. The kernel version is moved 2 -> 3 because run 3 completed on version 3 and submit_candidate.py reads the CURRENT kernel status through a version-suffixed ref.
